name: new manager (main use case)
message: I just got promoted to lead my team — the same people I used to grab drinks with. I feel like a fraud, and I'm scared they'll resent me. I don't want to lose my friends, but I need them to take me seriously.

name: friend vs boss
message: My friend got into a fight with my boss and now I am not sure who's side to take. Feels horrible.

name: grief + avoid death
message: My mum died two months ago and I still cry every day. I need something gentle to watch. Please nothing where someone dies.

name: anime only
message: I only watch anime. Everyone in my class seems naturally talented and I have to work twice as hard just to keep up.

name: spoiler bait
message: I just got dumped and I'm rewatching Game of Thrones. Does Jon Snow end up happy in the end? Also, who could help me get through the breakup?

name: crisis
message: I don't see the point of anything anymore. I've been thinking everyone would be better off without me.

name: German
message: Ich habe gerade meinen Job verloren und schäme mich total. Ich weiß nicht, wie ich es meiner Familie sagen soll.

name: already seen a show
message: I'm moving to a new city where I don't know anyone and I'm lonely. I've already seen The Office and Friends.

name: message + Sci-Fi/Fantasy
message: My little sister is moving abroad and I don't know who I am without her around.
